authority.original_documents: Google Drive and authorized owner stores

storage.public: Curated independent published snapshot with typed fields only; no original data or private source IDs
storage.private: Unexposed raf_private schema for metadata, typed lineage, receipts and approvals; no raw bodies in SQL tables
storage.large_objects: Private Supabase Storage bucket only after provider configuration and ACL/retention gate; originals remain at source until integrity verified
storage.secrets: External secret manager; never GitHub public files, client or Supabase rows

publication.method: separate review + promotion service, explicit snapshot by release
publication.precision_policy: Suppress small cells, location traces, identifier leakage and reconstruction by multiple charts
publication.public_revocation: new revocation event, invalidate cache/edge and snapshot status, retain private evidence under lawful retention

ingestion.discovery_scope: bounded approved source refs and metadata only

access.identity: per-request authentication and authorization; MFA for privileged paths
access.client: publishable key only; grants + RLS; never service role in browser
access.backend: least privilege; separate ingestion, approval and publication capabilities
access.external_tokens: PAT identifier is not proof of grant; no token replication or fallback

standards_intent.DMAIC: operational method, no statistical Six Sigma level
standards_intent.ISO_9001: quality management review, formal compliance not asserted
standards_intent.NIST_CSF_2_0: govern, identify, protect, detect, respond, recover
standards_intent.RFC/IEEE: apply only identified relevant technical standards; no blanket compliance assertion

provider.projects_observed: 2 projects INACTIVE at 2026-11-02; specific target not selected

gates: provider project selection and budget/activation authorization
explicit source ownership and lawful purpose by dataset
DPIA/LIA or applicable privacy analysis and child-safeguarding review
private RLS plus grants plus exposed schema verification
positive and negative anon/authenticated tenant fixtures
dual-review publication and precise provenance hash/receipt
no private source IDs or personal data in public map or chart output
independent review and exact-HEAD CI before merge

metrics.CTQ_provenance_coverage: count verified source objects / eligible objects (baseline TOKEN_VAZIO)
metrics.CTQ_public_leak: number of unauthorized disclosure fixtures passing (target 0, not observed)
metrics.CTQ_revocation: time from revocation decision to inaccessible public API and caches (not measured)
metrics.CTQ_cost: provider query and storage cost measured, not guessed

rollback: close unmerged PR; for any future provider activation require separate tested data-safe migration/backup and compensating revocation plan
